audit_method: Same-agent exact comparison against the frozen source, controlling rule displays, signed-formula definitions, proof-tree premises and conclusions, and proof-local semantics within that revision. No claim about current upstream master is made.

corrections.finding: The tableaux chapter driver calls the proof system natural deduction although its chapter, imports and prfTab profile all concern tableaux.
corrections.handling: Referred to tableaux and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The chapter title, every imported section and the controlling prfTab tag identify the system as tableaux.

corrections.finding: An exercise places a comma and negated formula inside the first signed-formula argument, so it is not one well-formed signed formula.
corrections.handling: Restored the negated formula as a separate true-signed assumption and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The signed-formula definition admits exactly one sentence after a sign, and the resulting three assumptions form the intended closed-tableau exercise.

corrections.finding: The transitivity proof applies the subset relation to an individual terminal sentence rather than to the finite collection of D-sentences.
corrections.handling: Restored braces around the finite subset and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The derivability definition requires a finite subset of Gamma and the next display lists precisely those D-sentences as assumptions.

corrections.finding: The second finite subset ends at C_n although its immediately displayed members and the remainder of the proof end at C_m.
corrections.handling: Restored terminal index m and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The following display, union argument and combined tableau all use C_1 through C_m.

corrections.finding: The proof says the true-negation rule is applied to false A, although it has just replaced that assumption by true not-A.
corrections.handling: Restored true not-A as the rule premise and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The displayed rule maps true not-A to false A, and the preceding sentence explicitly performs the required replacement.

corrections.finding: Four proof-tree nodes nest each formula inside the truth-sign argument and omit the signed-formula macro's second argument.
corrections.handling: Restored the two arguments in all four true-signed nodes and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The chapter definition and every well-formed neighbouring node pass the sign and formula as two distinct arguments.

corrections.finding: Four proof-tree nodes nest each formula inside the falsity-sign argument and omit the signed-formula macro's second argument.
corrections.handling: Restored the two arguments in all four false-signed nodes and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The chapter definition and every well-formed neighbouring node pass the sign and formula as two distinct arguments.

corrections.finding: An extraneous comma is placed inside the mathematical span after the final signed assumption.
corrections.handling: Removed the extraneous comma and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The preceding parallel proof item and the assumption list require no punctuation inside the formula span.

corrections.finding: Two quantified soundness cases switch their quantified premise from A to B while their conclusions and the rest of each argument remain about A.
corrections.handling: Used A consistently throughout both cases and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: Each displayed rule instance concludes A(t) or A(a), and every subsequent semantic and extensionality step is stated for A.

corrections.finding: The transitivity explanation calls line 2 the generic first equality t1=t2, although the declared predicate instance on that line is s1=s2.
corrections.handling: Restored the instantiated equality s1=s2 and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The displayed tableau's line 2 is s1=s2 and the sentence immediately defines A(x) as s1=x.

corrections.finding: The symmetry explanation names A(s2) as the second prerequisite although the rule instance needs A(s1) to infer A(s2).
corrections.handling: Restored A(s1) as the prerequisite and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: With t1=s1, t2=s2 and A(x) defined as x=s1, line 3 is A(s1) and the conclusion is A(s2).

corrections.finding: The soundness case for the true-identity rule gives its conclusion an undefined generic sign S even though both premises and the displayed rule use the true sign.
corrections.handling: Restored the true sign and added an adjacent keyed note.
corrections.controlling_evidence: The displayed true-identity rule maps true A(t1) to true A(t2), and this paragraph explicitly handles that rule.

reader_render: The final deterministic 144-page cumulative PDF and exact HTML reader both passed; every PDF page was rendered and visually inspected.
